World & Universe :

The Universe of Arlandia is created with an unique scripting system which makes everything dynamic. Here is a list of a few of the characteristics of this system :

- An universe with galaxies, star systems, planets, exteriors and interiors
- An infinite module, no areas number restriction
- Dynamic planet maps, auto-generated by the system
- Totally customisable star systems and planets if wanted
- Random generated creatures and resources
- Random generated towns, dungeons and other points of interests
- Player domains : economic activity center of the players
- Player shops, crafting, races, talents and much more...
- Close interactivity between the server and the website
- Persistent server with a SQL database using NWNX
- Website showing (live) server maps, with player and DM client
- Website showing (live) details for interest points, such as dungeons, public boards, player shops, etc.
- Ability to implement other links between the server and the website...
- and much more...

You can find more informations on the official website of this server.

Website :

The game experience may be increased if you play in combination with the official website of this server. The website contains many useful informations and it give you LIVE informations about some interesting things :

- Active maps with discovered areas
- Detail window for each interest points
- Player shop items, message boards, dungeons statut, domain activity sector, and much more...

So don't forget to have a look at the website as well as its forum for news and other things.

Wear :

All the items you are wearing will brake with time, like in real life. Some items may brake quickly while other will remain longer. If it happens you may fix it by a blacksmith.

You may also consider crafting or buying a new item instead of fixing it.

UOA book :

The book you are reading now give you all informations you need to play in the Universe of Arlandia module. Some informations may also be found on the official website of this server.

Transports :

If you are tired of walking or riding by yourself, you may take profit of the official transport systems of this Universe, for some money. There are mainly 2 transport types :

- Airships : travels from one city/town to another one.
- Spaceships : travels from one planet to another one.

Spaceship distance action is limited, so you may need to take it more than 1 time to go to a far place.

Players can get their own airship or starship station by building one in their domain.

Talents :

In addition to the basic skills and feats, players can also learn extra talents. Talents can be learned at any level and is accessible to every race and class.

Talents must be bought at a trainer shop and activated by a character to be learnt. Some talents may have multiple levels.

Check the official website of this server to see the available talents.

Shops :

Every city or town holds a few shops which contains a few things for sale. Most of the shops got unlimited items but some may be limited. Shops are chosen randomly by the system for each city or town.

The general shop also buy items, at 40% of the normal price.

The player shop works a bit differently, in the fact that it will sell your item for 75% of the normal price but you will only get the money when the item is sold, that means bought by another player. This shop is interesting for seller as well as for buyer, because insead of 100%-40% prices they will get 75%-75%. Cheaper for the buyer and more lucrative for the seller. The items for sale in the player shop can be seen on the official website of this server.

All the cities and towns hold a general shop, a player shop, a blacksmith, an inn, a tavern and a special shop, chosen randomly by the system.

Resources :

The natural and primary resources are essential to build anything and everything you can see was built with resources. They may be combined or transformed to be used but they are indispensable.

See the crafting table in the "Crafting & Powers" section to see how resources can be combined and what final items can be crafted.

Resting :

After some fights or long journeys, you will need to have quite rest moments. Better choose a place away from hostile creatures.

To be able to rest, you need one food ration. Additional items can give you hit points bonuses :

- bedroll : +10 HPs
- small tent : +10% HPs
- medium tent : +20% HPs
- big tent : +30% HPs
- campfire : +20 HPs

Bedrolls and tents may brake after a while.

Reputation points :

Your reputation tells how known and famous you are in the universe. Now they can only be won by playing DM campaigns, but later there may be other ways to get some.

Reputation points have no use yet. It will be added later.

Races :

Additionaly to the normal classes, you can play a range of monster classes, going from the fey to the minotaur.

Check the official website of this server to see the other playable races and their bonuses/maluses.

PvP :

Player versus Player is allowed in UOA, but gives no adventages to the killer out of some role-play satisfaction. It may change in the future if empires choose to make war against each others.

Permanency :

UOA uses the best system of databases to keep permanency for a lot of things. Here is a list of what will be permanent and how :

- Areas, interests and domains are permanent and visible on the website.
- Items put in oxes, player chests, player shops and mailboxes will remain permanent.
- Fournitures placed in player houses will remain permanent.

On the other hand, items dropped on the ground will be destroyed at the server reboot. So don't put items on the ground, you will loose them !

Missions & Plots :

Although wandering to interest points or even to find creatures and resources may be enough interesting, you may want to have other goals and to work for somebody.

In each city and town you will find a plotgiver (you can recognize them by the asterisk (*) following their name) who will offer you a few jobs. There are 5 types of jobs :

- Take back items
- Find resources
- Bring note
- Take back creatures
- Kill monsters

Each mission is rewarded in xps and gold pieces. The shift is also rewarded in xps.

Interests :

The point of interest in the Universe of Arlandia are the most rich and interesting places players can visit. What are called "interests" are :

- towns.
- dungeons
- castles
- ruins
- animals reserves
- resources mountains
- amusement places
- domains

Each of these interest can be split in many sub-interests with unique properties.

Check the official website of this server to see the details of each interest point. Check the maps to see where discovered interests are, too.

How to begin ?

Welcome ! If this is your first day in the Universe of Arlandia, don't panic. This is a very rich and huge world but you will learn it step-by-step by playing. And there is nothing hard to understand, no complex system in any domain.

You are in the city of Arlandia, which is the main city of the Arland planet. You just finished your education and you are now ready to adventure on your own. You may first look at the general shop (north area of Arlandia) to buy some useful stuff. You should buy the resources tools (tool axe, tool pick, tool sickle) to be able to cut resources. You ma also buy some bullets for your sling. If you still got some coins, you may buy torches, a second bedroll and other things.

When equipped, and before you go out of the city, you may go to the city sewers to check your combat feats (good for beginners). The sewers in Arlandia only contain neutral tiny level 1 creatures, easy to catch and to kill. Make your first experiences under the city. Once you feel comfortable with yourself, you may try to get an eye out of the city. But take care, some of the wild animals may be angry of your presence.

You can also take mission by the plot giver, which you can find south of the Arlandia marketplace.

We hope you will enjoy your journey in the Universe of Arlandia and that you will explore many places in the star systems of this galaxy. You may even rule it one day...

Henchs :

In this world you will be able to command up to 99 henchs. The henchs can be various types, either bought henchs, domain henchs or creatures given as hench to you by a DM.

By talking with your hench, you will be able to give it some orders.

Animals have special powers and bonuses. For example an ox can carry stuff for you. Check an animal shop to see what animal you can buy.

While riding horses, you will better manage it if you have the feat or riding skill points.

Feats :

What is called feats here are your professional specialisation in one of the available activities. It is independant of your normal skills and feats, and of your talents or domain activities.

Check the official website of this server to see the available feats.

Puzzles :

While journeying in this Universe, you may fall on some static items asking you to solve a puzzle to gain xps points or to go further. This is an interesting way to enjoy this world and to progress in many abilities.

Domains :

Domains are the economic and politic activity center of players. They can be built everywhere without number limit.

Once a domain is built, the owner can build a lot of different structures to settle his activity. Check the official website of this server to see all the possibilities and what you get with each one.

DMs & Campaigns :

As in each server, the Universe of Arlandia may also have DMs managing the game or organising official campaigns.

DMs have a special tool, the "DM tool", that lets them do a huge amount of actions on characters and on the system (if you are or want to be a DM, log in as it and check this tool).

Death & Life points :

If you die you will be sent to the death planet, where your soul will give you the possibility to resurect, but with a cost. You can choose two possibilities :

- resurect and loose xps.
- resurect and loose 1 life point.

Life points can be gained by visiting a temple. By loosing a part of the resurection xps, you can "buy" a life point.

Creatures :

There are a lot of different creatures living in the Universe, and even on each planet. Each creature, animal or monster, has unique properties and unique remains.

There are 9 levels or creatures, depending on the planet level. The higher the level is, the more powerful creatures will be found on a planet.

Resources, treasures and other random stuff is also dependant of the planet levels.

Crafting :

Is is quite important to learn to craft some items by itself because shops don't always got all the needed stuff and are also rares on each planet.

Everybody can craft items using the combinations shown in this book, but crafting requires skill points (Craft Armor, Craft Trap, Craft Weapon). The more points a character got in these skills, the more powerful items he will be able to craft without failing at each try. Characters can not equip two magical items with the same magical properties.

To see the crafting table, go back to the main menu of this book and choose "Crafting & Powers".

Classes & Levels :

In this world, classes are rebalanced, so that each class in interesting to play and is equal in terms of power and strength. The weak classes (bard, rogue, druid, etc.) get bonuses and more xps than the strong classes (cleric, fighter, sorcerer, etc.), who get maluses. Here is the table of the xps distribution :

XPs x 140% : Bard.
XPs x 120% : Druid, Monk, Ranger, Rogue.
XPs x 100% : Barbarian, Paladin.
XPs x 80% : Fighter, Sorcerer, Wizard.
XPs x 60% : Cleric.

Additional bonuses and maluses can be applied.

Analyser :

The analyser is an "all-in-one" tool that let you analyse some items or area properties. Here are the functions of the analyser :

- activate on an item : check the item wear.
- activate on the ground : check the area number.
